release_gates.requirement: Root verifies current main commit, actual release count, uniqueness and exact permitted release policy. 209 is an expected historical baseline, not established by this package.
Record separate seven-ID bounded publication disposition under current policy without rewriting formal candidate acceptance or unrun GPU/scene stages.

Use current trusted main ModelStage/render preset and pinned Chromium on exactly these seven GLBs; preserve source hashes, viewer/preset hash, renderer identity and dimensions. Capture reference PNG and card WebP; do not use CPU proof/concept images.
Inspect actual captured pixels for silhouette, materials, clipping, background and card/detail continuity; verify image digests and exact source GLB identity. Stalactites must remain ceiling-mounted.
Verify seven cards and detail GLB first paint, wheel/orbit, desktop/mobile, return/close, preview fallback and no GPU-count inflation; produce actual evidence on selected final integration baseline.
Serial root integration only: incremental collector/manifest/allowlist updates, current release checks and CI for exact final commit. No collector or manifest has been changed here.
Only root under existing user authorization: verify expected remote commit, successful deployment, actual catalog inclusion and exact live download hashes before saying live.

formal_candidate_gates.note: Software ModelStage capture when later run does not establish a physical hardware GPU pass. Bounded release policy is not formal production acceptance.
